annotation.summary: Reconstructed and validated the verification-only circular-area callpoint harness with one canonical mixed-buffer resource. The r2 seed-lib parse blocker was repaired by using parser-valid no-space &(...) field-address notation. Init starts at repeat None; metadata/reset preserve mixed ownership; writes initialize exactly one destination option; reads require live cells to be Some; release consumes every reachable mixed state. The general nonempty one-byte Write post now returns the mathematically correct existential new status instead of incorrectly forcing status 0 when a write may fill the ring.

spec_definition_review.mathematical_semantics: CircularAreaLogicalState is a representation relation, not an executable replay of C control flow. It relates FIFO length, indices, full status, byte bounds, physical option-list length, and every live ring cell. CircularAreaBackingResource adds exact ownership of all descriptor fields and UCharArray.mixed_full; free cells remain unconstrained between None and Some.
spec_definition_review.write_effect: Both one-byte Write contracts fix physical1 = replace_Znth(destination, Some(byte), physical). The general nonempty post returns an existential new_status constrained by CircularAreaLogicalState, so capacity-reaching writes have status 1 and shorter writes status 0.
spec_definition_review.read_effect: A nonempty logical list guarantees every live position is Some of its logical byte; live Read advances the read index and initializes exactly the caller output, while empty Read preserves its undefined output.
spec_definition_review.reset_effect: Reset empties the logical live interval while preserving the physical option-list and never claims physical bytes were erased.

annotation_checking_evidence.summary: The specs express ring/FIFO semantics and exact observable metadata results, not merely bounds or shape. Init yields mixed ownership at repeat None; Read accesses only live Some cells; Write initializes exactly its destination; Reset preserves physical initialization while emptying the logical state; Release consumes all mixed states. Every required wrapper reaches Release on success and preserves caller resources on failure.
